# AthenaRun

> AthenaRun is an autonomous software creation platform that turns a written
> business goal into a production-ready business application — database,
> workflows, permissions and frontend included — without developers.
> Operated by AthenaRun GmbH, Frankfurt am Main, Germany.

AthenaRun is built for business teams rather than engineering teams: HR and
People Ops, Operations, Compliance and executive teams that need internal
software but have no developer capacity. It is not a low-code tool where you
assemble components yourself, and not a prompt-to-prototype builder: you define
a business goal, and AthenaRun autonomously generates the complete application.

## Key facts

- Category: autonomous software creation / AI business applications
- Built for: HR & People, Operations, Compliance, Executive teams
- Developers required: 0 — no code is written or maintained by hand
- Time to a working application: about 1 day, versus roughly 3 months for a
  traditional development project; deployment goes live in under 5 minutes
- Hosting: on your own servers or in the cloud
- Uptime guarantee: 99.9% on automatically scaling global infrastructure
- Development cost per project: roughly 95% lower than a traditional build
- Getting started: free, no credit card required, free initial consultation
- Company: AthenaRun GmbH, Friedrich-Ebert-Anlage 36, 60325 Frankfurt am Main,
  Germany — Amtsgericht Frankfurt am Main
- Contact: hello@athenarun.ai

## How it works

1. Define the goal — describe user roles and business goals in plain language,
   for example "onboarding portal for new HR employees".
2. Autonomous generation — AthenaRun creates the databases, workflows,
   permissions and frontend automatically in the background.
3. Launch — the software is immediately productive, scalable and secure,
   hosted on your servers or in the cloud.

## Common questions

- What is AthenaRun? See the summary above.
- Do I need developers? No. AthenaRun requires zero developers and leaves no
  technical debt, because no one hand-writes the code.
- How is it different from low-code platforms and AI app builders? AthenaRun
  generates one complete, running production system from a business goal,
  rather than a prototype or a set of components you assemble yourself.
- Where is my data hosted? Applications can run on your own servers or in the
  cloud, so data-residency requirements stay under your control.
- What does it cost? Free to start, no credit card required; roughly 95% lower
  development cost per project than a traditional software build.
